title: BOHR: beta one-zero hybrid regression
description: BOHR (beta one-zero hybrid regression) is an R package for regression of proportions in [0, 1] that contain exact zeros and ones. The response is modelled with a zero-and-one-inflated beta distribution, and a predictor's effect is tested separately on the probability of 0 (p0), the probability of 1 (p1) and the mean of the values in between (μ). The genomics layer maps genetic effects on these components (cis-QTL mapping). The repository also holds the analysis code of Dong et al., Genetic regulation of alternative promoter usage with BOHR reveals distinct modes of transcription initiation, in paper/.
